transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize any stocking decisions for the rare emergency antidote, I'd like to hear from our clinical, pharmacy, and finance representatives about their implementation requirements. As a reminder, we have a designated locked cabinet available in the medication room that could house a new emergency medication, so storage is not a barrier. I want to make sure we've thoroughly reviewed all requirements before I make a final decision on whether and how to stock it here at the satellite ED.

transcript.text: From a pharmacy logistics standpoint, I've confirmed the antidote must be stored at 2-8 degrees Celsius. The satellite department's medication refrigerator has available space, and we can implement a temperature-log check at the start of each shift to ensure proper cold chain compliance. So refrigerated storage is feasible on our end.
